trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Centrally located V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 95 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:5 relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by distinct peaks and valleys; amplitudes are most pronounced in the medial sections of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge resulting in an upward sweep towards acute, slightly recurved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity white pixels located at the terminal points of both lobes, suggesting high-contrast scarring or epibiont attachments.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged and irregular tissue margins on the extreme lateral tips of the fluke, particularly the right tip, which exhibits a more elongated and fragmented profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible dorsal surface displays a highly uniform low-intensity pixel distribution with minimal variation, contrasting sharply with the saturated high-intensity background.
